principle: Scientific experiment gates and corpus-engineering gates are independent. A sealed prospective experiment must remain sealed while source, provenance, catalogue, rights, and representation work continues.

machine_resolvable.completion_scope: 802 checksum-authenticated local canonical source records; not independently verified inscriptions.

machine_resolvable.completion_scope: 802 inscription/provenance rows, 5,144 occurrence rows and source-label site counts exported locally; root historical CSV scaffolds remain historical.

machine_resolvable.task: Reconcile the 15 named unresolved cases against lawful primary images/plates or independent authoritative witnesses where accessible.

Cross-script phonetic equivalence remains unestablished. Completion is the source-layer concordance and gap register, not independent adjudication or cross-script correspondence.

sealed_or_external.reason: Historical analytical input identity/independence unresolved; do not inspect outcomes.

ceiling_rule: Do not declare PRE_EXPERT_MAXIMUM until every machine_resolvable item is COMPLETE or SOURCE_BLOCKED with a concrete access/rights blocker.
public_record_boundary: All 802 entries, 5,144 slots, 1,401 editorial groups and 376 source sign entries from one authenticated SigLA derivative are public as licensed source-only JSONL under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 with attribution. Primary-edition images remain private. The ten-entry critical pilot supplies separate edition evidence; Raison–Pope reconciliation, physical object identities and independent expert review remain open.
